steps.name: Fetch the source-bound Python policy baseline
steps.run:
# The event supplies the comparison commit; this is source input, not a base-branch test run.
# tools/ci_python_policy.py
base="$(python3 -c 'import json,os; from tools.ci_python_policy import event_baseline; print(event_baseline(os.environ["GITHUB_EVENT_NAME"], json.load(open(os.environ["GITHUB_EVENT_PATH"], encoding="utf-8")), os.environ["GITHUB_SHA"]))')"
git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "$base"
printf 'LSF_PYTHON_POLICY_BASE=%s\n' "$base" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Install Python validator dependencies
Isolate Rustup after setup failure
Retry the pinned Rust toolchain in the isolated home
Restore compiled Rust dependencies
Install the verified wasm-tools release asset
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
archive="$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-wasm-tools.tar.gz"
bindir="$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-wasm-tools-bin"
mkdir "$bindir"
timeout 90s gh api -H 'Accept: application/octet-stream' repos/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/releases/assets/483720667 | head -c 5862465 > "$archive"
unset GH_TOKEN
test "$(stat --format=%s "$archive")" = 5862464
printf '%s  %s\n' d0efb16c9c859137b7ab3e99151c299cd47caee106ed4594561002f7a04945bd "$archive" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xOzf "$archive" wasm-tools-1.254.0-x86_64-linux/wasm-tools > "$bindir/wasm-tools"
test "$(stat --format=%s "$bindir/wasm-tools")" = 20231696
printf '%s  %s\n' cc1f862d69363aac2d4a88f01c414a2dcf10858632d0c0a45e93ff60503979d6 "$bindir/wasm-tools" | sha256sum --check --strict
chmod 755 "$bindir/wasm-tools"
test "$("$bindir/wasm-tools" --version)" = 'wasm-tools 1.254.0 (bb58fdf91 2026-07-20)'
printf '%s\n' "$bindir" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Install the verified Buf release asset
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
archive="$RUNNER_TEMP/lsf-buf-1.72.0.tar.gz"
destination="$RUNNER_TEMP/lsf-buf-1.72.0"
mkdir "$destination"
timeout 120s gh api -H 'Accept: application/octet-stream' repos/bufbuild/buf/releases/assets/480772583 | head -c 37851982 > "$archive"
unset GH_TOKEN
test "$(stat --format=%s "$archive")" = 37851981
printf '%s  %s\n' a9c6186cf6fcf062b247345e1b7b12c26f580c1b2a4bbf4d3fe080abf85ceee8 "$archive" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$archive" -C "$destination" buf/bin/buf buf/bin/protoc-gen-buf-breaking buf/bin/protoc-gen-buf-lint
bindir="$destination/buf/bin"
test "$(stat --format=%s "$bindir/buf")" = 54050978
test "$(stat --format=%s "$bindir/protoc-gen-buf-breaking")" = 41365666
test "$(stat --format=%s "$bindir/protoc-gen-buf-lint")" = 30810274
printf '%s  %s\n' \
  8720830e26a733da55bb89bcd3cb44849c0965fc0c44fb5d691cccdc64dca5af "$bindir/buf" \
  58cece373a057f6031bcbab1fdab1a774206b2ad15617fe61ae7bb1adda2b745 "$bindir/protoc-gen-buf-breaking" \
  6b50ee2ef0876c73ad430522ee98c7070e41eaabeba649256278bd8dc92571a1 "$bindir/protoc-gen-buf-lint" | sha256sum --check --strict
chmod 755 "$bindir/buf" "$bindir/protoc-gen-buf-breaking" "$bindir/protoc-gen-buf-lint"
test "$("$bindir/buf" --version)" = 1.72.0
printf '%s\n' "$bindir" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
